answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 1173 Country: United Kingdom Title: Are Muslims allowed to trim the sides of the beard (sideburns, upper cheek and stray long hairs)? Question: Are Muslims allowed to trim the sides of the beard (sideburns, upper cheek and stray long hairs)? Answer ID: 1173 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 840/841=J) The raised bone below ears is the starting point of beard; therefore the sideburns fall in beard and it is not allowed to shave or trim them below one fist. The hairs on cheeks are not from beard; therefore they can be shaved, but it is better to avoid it also. As far as the matter of stray long hairs is concerned they can be trimmed as long as they are one fist. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
